title: Enterprise Support: Effective compute unit price for paid rate-error review
content:
Enterprise Support — Effective compute unit price for paid rate-error review.

## Decision basis

For paid rate-error review: Multiply the selected compute unit price once by one minus its applicable compute discount to obtain the effective cloud rate; all source intervals in this reconciliation use US East and on-demand standard configuration.

## Hypothetical case

For paid rate-error review: A hypothetical selected compute unit price of USD 0.80 and applicable discount of 25 percent yield an effective price of USD 0.60 per vCPU-hour. The reduction acts once on the selected unit price.
